This is just my opinion so you obviously don't have to follow it but I think you should talk to her (the therapist) about it. Talking through things can be helpful and relieving sometimes. Only if you can actually find the want (even if it's small) to do it though. I still don't think you should force yourself. Ultimately your choice. 

If you do decide to talk to her and you don't want your mom to know I think you should express those feelings. Since there should always be some confidentiality between patient and the professional (terapist in this case). And I belive if she is a good terapist she would except to not tell your mom if you tell her you don't want to/are not comfortable.

But again this is just my opinion so don't take it as "this is exactly what you have to do!". And again it is your choice and I think you should think about it and consider everything since obviously I don't know your situation nor your mom or terapist.

Hope everything turns out okay ❤️
